question: When and where must śrāddha be performed on full-moon days?
premises: Performance must occur within sight of akṣa
inference: Śrāddha should be performed on full-moon days within sight of the akṣa.
uncertainties: akṣagocare may refer to a specific place or visible marker
plain_english: And śrāddha should be performed on full-moon days within sight of the akṣa.
